name: AprtCleInteger.java
summary: Implements the APR-CL primality proving algorithm with Montgomery arithmetic for large integers, providing Jacobi sum evaluation, exponentiation, and Miller-Rabin probabilistic prime testing.

name: Classical.java
summary: Implements classical trial division factorization, dividing by small primes up to a bound while checking for primality and even factors.

name: Lehman.java
summary: Implements Lehman's factorization algorithm as a Thread, using perfect square detection with modular residue tables for efficient trial factoring.

name: ECM.java
summary: Top-level entry point for the Elliptic Curve Method factorization, orchestrating ECM steps and switching to SIQS for numbers in the 30-90 digit range.

name: ecmStep0.java
summary: Initializes ECM elliptic curve parameters: generates small primes, sets up Montgomery curve coefficients A and coordinates (X:Z) for step 1.

name: ecmStep1.java
summary: Performs ECM step 1: computes scalar multiples of a point on the elliptic curve using Montgomery's ladder with Lucas chains (prac algorithm).

name: ecmStep2.java
summary: Performs ECM step 2 using improved standard continuation with sieving, computing differences of multiples of Q and accumulating GCDs to find factors.

name: FirstPolynomial.java
summary: Abstract base for SIQS polynomial initialization, computing leading coefficient A, linear coefficients, and sieve data for the first polynomial in each set.

name: Maths.java
summary: Provides linear algebra operations for SIQS: Block Lanczos setup, binary matrix operations (mult, add, transpose), singleton erasure, and column exchange utilities.

name: Matrix.java
summary: Implements the Block Lanczos algorithm for finding the nullspace of a sparse binary matrix over GF(2) with block size 32.

name: Relation.java
summary: Manages smooth and partial congruence relations in SIQS: detects full factorizations, matches partials via hash map, and inserts relations into the sparse matrix.

name: Sieve.java
summary: SIQS sieving thread: performs polynomial evaluation, trial division, smooth/partial relation detection, and reports results back to the main SIQS orchestrator.

name: Siqs.java
summary: Top-level orchestrator for the Self-Initializing Quadratic Sieve: manages factor base generation, Knuth-Schroeppel multiplier selection, thread spawning, and result collection.

name: StaticFunctions.java
summary: Utility class with static methods for SIQS algorithm including binary search, Jacobi symbol, modular inverse, SQUFOF factoring, and probabilistic primality testing

name: ConvertBase.java
summary: Encapsulates a base-conversion operation for the calculator, validating that the base falls within the range 2 to 36.

name: Deque.java
summary: A dynamic double-ended queue (deque) that grows as needed, supporting add/remove/get operations at both front and back.

name: EmptyDequeException.java
summary: A simple exception class thrown when attempting to access an element in an empty Deque.

name: Main.java
summary: Entry point that generates a semiprime from two probable primes and runs the Quadratic Sieve factorization

name: BigPrimesList.java
summary: Tracks big prime factors found during sieving, storing vectors grouped by shared prime for later combination

name: Logger.java
summary: Base logging class with timestamped output, number formatting, and array/list pretty-printing

name: QuadraticSieve.java
summary: Quadratic Sieve factorization implementation with multi-threaded sieving, wheel initialization, B-smooth vector collection, and solution solving via matrix reduction

name: VectorData.java
summary: Data class holding a BitSet vector, sieve position, big prime index, and cached x/y values for matrix solution

name: BitMatrix.java
summary: Gaussian elimination over GF(2) using BitSet rows to find nullspace vectors that yield factorizations

name: VectorsShrinker.java
summary: Reduces the vector set by merging vectors sharing the same big prime, assigning indices and XORing their bit vectors

name: Wheel.java
summary: Sieve wheel that iterates over positions in the sieve interval where a prime divides Q(x), using Tonelli-Shanks solutions

name: MathUtils.java
summary: Number-theoretic utilities: quadratic residue testing (Euler criterion), Tonelli-Shanks algorithm for modular square roots, and Lucas sequence evaluation

name: SqrRoot.java
summary: BigInteger square root ceiling function

name: GCD.java
summary: Binary GCD algorithm for large integers represented as 31-bit digit arrays, with power-of-two factor extraction

name: ModInv.java
summary: Modular inverse for large integers using the extended binary GCD with 32-bit digit representation and Montgomery-like multi-precision arithmetic

name: LucasLehmer.java
summary: Lucas-Lehmer primality test for Mersenne numbers (2^p-1) with a Swing GUI progress bar. Contains LucasLehmer class (main, constructor, run, isPrime) and a package-private PrimeThread class that wraps BigInteger.isProbablePrime for comparison. Uses a Zeef sieve to get small primes and runs tests in a thread pool.

name: README.TXT
summary: Documentation for the primality test package. Explains Lucas-Lehmer test for Mersenne numbers (2^p-1) and APR-CL (Adleman-Pomerance-Rumely-Cohen-Lenstra) general primality test using cyclotomic polynomials and modular arithmetic.

name: AprtCle.ctxt

name: AprtCle.java
summary: APR-CL (Adleman-Pomerance-Rumely-Cohen-Lenstra) primality test implementation. Extends AprtCleFinal. The main isProbablePrime method performs Jacobi sum computations, modular exponentiation, Montgomery multiplication, and exponent-level matching to determine primality. Supports multi-level trial factoring with quadratic bounds, falling back to Miller-Rabin (isProbablePrimeRobin) for numbers too large to test.

name: AprtCleFinal.java
summary: Base class for APR-CL primality testing. Contains Final() which performs the final verification step: converting number to Montgomery form, computing N mod S iteratively with modular multiplication, checking for composite/prime conditions. Also contains check() which computes Jacobi sum normalization and matching for both odd primes (P != 2) and powers of 2 (P == 2, K=1,2,3+).

summary: APR-CL static data and variable definitions. Defines PWmax=32, Qmax=30241, LEVELmax=11.

name: FibonacciCheck.java
summary: Fibonacci-based factoring check. Extends LucasCheck, overrides Factor to use GCD with Fibonacci numbers F(k) and F(Index/k) at each divisor k of the input index. Also uses InsertLucasFactor from the parent for Lucas sequence factoring.

name: LucasCheck.ctxt
summary: BlueJ class context descriptor for LucasCheck. Defines Javadoc comments for the LucasCheck class, Check, Factor, InsertLucasFactor, and get methods.

name: LucasCheck.java
summary: Lucas sequence-based factoring check. Detects if the input number is a Lucas number by checking bit length and iterating the Lucas sequence (L_n). InsertLucasFactor extracts factors by iterating divisors k of Index and computing GCD with Lucas numbers L(k) and L(Index/k), with special handling for factors of 5. Also provides static get() for generating Fibonacci/Lucas numbers.

name: PowerCheck.ctxt
summary: BlueJ class context descriptor for PowerCheck. Defines Javadoc comments for the PowerCheck class, constructor, and Check method.

name: PowerCheck.java
summary: Perfect power detection for factoring. Uses a probabilistic filter with primes of the form 2310x+1 to eliminate impossible exponents (2,3,5,7,11), then an Eratosthenes-sieve-based filter over all primes up to 2*maxExpon+3. For remaining candidates, computes the integer k-th root via Newton iteration and checks if root^Exponent == N. Uses log2 approximation for initial root estimate.

name: PowerPM1Check.ctxt
summary: BlueJ class context descriptor for PowerPM1Check. Defines Javadoc comments for the PowerPM1Check class, constructor, Check, ProcessExponent, and Cunningham methods.

name: PowerPM1Check.java
summary: Perfect power detection for numbers of the form a^e +/- 1 (Cunningham numbers). Contains precomputed factorization maps for Mersenne (2^p-1) and Fermat (2^(2^k)+1) numbers. Check() uses modular residue filters and log approximation to find candidate exponents. ProcessExponent computes integer k-th roots of N+1 and N-1 via Newton iteration. Cunningham() inserts known primitive factors and Aurifeuillian factors.
